action.text: The ERP submits 300 high-value invoices. Only the approval subscription accepts them.
Approved invoices become PostInvoice commands; originals remain archived.
A schema mismatch makes every ledger attempt fail. Commands are retried five times.
Poison commands are quarantined in the DLQ for operator replay.
